plan.objective: Establish a decisive flying clock while controlling the visible oversized trample threat; preserve a meaningful blocker and any useful interaction.
plan.guidance: Finish: No guaranteed finish now. Kellan is a 3/2 double striker, but Explorer is an available 8/10 blocker, so Kellan cannot be counted on for the six damage; no burn or evasion is in hand. The precombat Mountain does not change that. Do not attack Kellan into the trade. Danger: Explorer is tapped currently but can attack next turn despite being summoning sick now; its 8 power with trample threatens lethal from your 18 life only after further growth, not presently. If it attacks as 8/10, block with Sanctuary: it absorbs 3 and only 5 tramples through, Sanctuary dies, you survive at 13. There is no known response in hand; preserve the blocker through the opponent's turn. Commitment: Apply sequencing/resources policy: play the drawn Mountain first, then cast Smaug for {2}{R}{R} using two Mountains for red and one Mountain plus the new Mountain for generic; retain both Sanctuaries untapped as a blocker and future resource. Smaug has haste and can attack, but Explorer can block its 4/3 flying body? Explorer has no flying, so it cannot block Smaug; attack with Smaug and send Kellan only if accepting Explorer's block does not create a bad exchange (keep Kellan back). Smaug's attack trigger has zero Treasures, so target opponent for no damage. Keep the animated Sanctuary untapped to block Explorer next turn.

phases.guidance: There is no instant or removal in hand. Explorer's current 8 power is not lethal through Sanctuary: block, take 5 trample, and keep Kellan back. Reassess if visible growth makes the attack lethal.
